rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" find . -type f -print | xargs chmod 644
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/tcltk/" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"tcllib* \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/tcltk/"
